proposals: APEDA should publish buffalo-meat export volumes and values by destination country every quarter, as MPEDA does for shrimp, so that the roles of Vietnam, Egypt, Malaysia, Iraq and Saudi Arabia can be stated in tonnes rather than described qualitatively.

APEDA should release its list of about 513 export-registered abattoirs and processing plants as a machine-readable file with category, state and registration date, so that the concentration of capacity in Uttar Pradesh and other states can be measured instead of read off category PDFs.

The Petroleum Ministry should publish biodiesel blending achieved each year against the B5 target for 2030, split by feedstock — used cooking oil, tallow and others, so that tallow’s roughly 3% share is tracked from official data rather than private estimates.

APEDA and the Export Inspection Council should require registered plants to report tallow generated and the category of buyer it is sold to, so that the volume available to a tallow-biodiesel supply chain is known before collection logistics are planned around it.
